description: The chart in Figure 4 illustrates the popularity of generated entities and ground-truth entities in both correctly and incorrectly answered samples across different categories. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled as "Movies", "Songs", and "Basketball", while the vertical axis is labeled "Popularity" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 220. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a category and containing six bars: three solid-colored bars representing the popularity of generated entities for the models Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT, and three patterned bars representing the popularity of ground-truth entities for the same models, as well as the popularity of ground-truth entities in correctly answered samples. The bars for Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT are colored blue, red, and yellow, respectively. The popularity values for the "Movies" category are around 20 for all models and entity types, while for "Songs", the values range from approximately 40 to 60. In the "Basketball" category, the popularity values are significantly higher, with the generated entities for Llama3 and Qwen2 reaching around 180 and 160, respectively, and ChatGPT's generated entities at around 200, while the ground-truth entities in correctly answered samples are around 100 for all models. The bars within each category are not sorted in a specific order, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar.
